source.note: by hand, 2026-11-04: drill H of docs/design/2026-11-04-rove-2.md (the rover's half of the heal). A Rover at a quarter of its health roves with a construction turret of ours 1,450 to its east under the turret's standing order and his extractor 1,870 to its north. Expected: the Rover walks to the turret first, stands in its reach until 90 %, then goes for the extractor. (The first placing at (2600, 4300) stood on ground no move order left, hurt or whole: the probe scan read it flat, the engine would not path from it.)
